text:
arek: Heads-up from the periodic RBAC sweep: exported prod role bindings and found 9 principals with 'infra-admin' or equivalent on redis-prod and analytics-prod. 5 are human, 4 are service accounts. 2 svcaccts have cross-account AWS KMS grants. export link: https://redwood.internal/s/exports/access-sweep-2026Q1.csv :mag_right:

devops-bot: automated note: vulnerabilities flagged if unused admin >90d + external KMS grants present. See CSV.

claire: Can someone paste the exact aws command to inspect grants? Want to include in the ops playbook.

owen: For AWS KMS run: 
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234-ab12-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab
# check GranteePrincipal values, look for arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/external-role or service account principals
```
Also check CloudTrail for "Decrypt" events referencing that key.

claire: Note - removing grant will immediately block decrypt for any running tasks that rely on that grant. We need a safe sequence: 1) confirm no active decrypts in last 7d, 2) notify owners, 3) schedule rotation+rewrap if removing.

tasha: I did a quick scan: one svcacct (ci-release@redwood-prod) shows Decrypt events 4 months ago but none in last 120 days; another (legacy-sync@) shows none in 400+ days. Might be stale.

arek: Proposed workflow: a) create outreach tickets with minimal repro: principal, last-auth, key ARN, last-decrypt event. b) set 5d owner SLA. c) if no response -> mark for removal and schedule key rotation in maintenance window with SRE+infra present. d) if owner responds "active", pair with code owner to refactor to least-priv pattern before rotation.

legal-bot: Reminder: key rotation affecting customer PII requires documented attestation and an archival proof-of-reencrypt. Add legal review step before final rotation for keys classified as PII.

own: I'll draft the ticket template and add checklist items: snapshot key policy, list-grants, last 30d CloudTrail decrypts, and a service-runbook link. Example ticket body: 
```
``nPrincipal: ci-release@redwood-prod
Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd1234
Last Decrypt: 2025-11-02T07:11Z
Suggested action: owner confirm -> safe rotation (2h off-peak) -> rewrap + smoke tests
```

claire: Also add an exemption path for infra SAs that are used by open-source onboarding or external partners. Exemptions expire in 30 days unless owner renews.

tasha: Quick vuln triage note: a recent CVE in a third-party redis client could be exploited by a compromised admin credential. Removing stale infra-admin principals reduces blast radius. We should prioritize principals with >1 year of inactivity.

arek: Action assignments: arek -> run owner outreach (5d SLA), owen -> infra rotation support, tasha -> vuln impact summary for compliance, claire -> maintain whitelist and expiry, legal-bot -> add legal review requirement for PII keys. Follow-up sync Friday 09:00 PT.

devops-bot: thread added to monthly security digest and tagged 'least-privilege-sweep'.

arek: small ask: when we rotate, ensure we publish a post-rotation checklist in the ops runbook and include the smoke tests (read/write sample re-encrypt verify). I'll post sample smoke commands after we sync.
